name: Default
shortDescription: Fladder web client for Jellyfin, served by the official rootless nginx image as a static web app with no server-side data.

alerts.message: Fladder is only a frontend: it needs an existing Jellyfin server reachable over HTTPS from your browser. Enter its URL on the login screen, or preset it for every user with BASE_URL (this hides the server field).
